stem: A Massachusetts resident retail pharmacy has one pharmacist on duty. The pharmacist takes a 20-minute meal break in an on-premises staff room under the pharmacy's written break procedures and reasonably believes drug security will be maintained. Which actions are consistent with the temporary-absence rule? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: Release an unchecked refill because it was dispensed by the same pharmacy last month.
Allow pickup of a new prescription already prepared, visibly checked, and reviewed for drug utilization by the pharmacist, using the required transaction log and subsequent pharmacist call.
Have the pharmacist leave the pharmacy premises while remaining reachable by phone.
Continue non-discretionary technical tasks and have the pharmacist review the work upon return.

choice_analysis_ko.A: 이전 조제 이력만으로 이번 refill의 약사 확인 및 상담 불필요 판단을 대체하지 못한다.
choice_analysis_ko.B: 9.19(17)(b)의 사전 준비·visible check·DUR, 환자 전화번호 포함 log, 복귀 후 합리적 시간 내 전화와 적절한 상담 경로다.
choice_analysis_ko.C: (17)(a)는 prescription area 밖 휴식을 허용하지만 premises 안에 남도록 한다.
choice_analysis_ko.D: (17)(c)는 비재량 업무를 허용하며 복귀 후 약사 검토를 요구한다.

difference: Generic four-true-statement recap becomes a resident single-pharmacist pickup/task decision including the new-prescription exception.
implementation: Draft only; no previous ID or answer history changed.
